nodes.name: basecommand.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the core command infrastructure including the CommandName enum with all 38 execCommand variants, CssPropertyName for mapping commands to CSS properties, RecordedStateOfCommand for tracking state/value overrides, and the main execute dispatch method.

nodes.name: backcolor.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the backColor execCommand, validating and applying CSS background-color to the current selection with simple color string normalization.

nodes.name: bold.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the bold execCommand, toggling font-weight between bold and normal on the current selection via inline CSS.

nodes.name: createlink.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the createLink execCommand, wrapping selected content in HTMLAnchorElement elements with the specified href URL.

nodes.name: defaultparagraphseparator.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the defaultParagraphSeparator execCommand, configuring the document default container element type (div or p) for new paragraph insertions.

nodes.name: delete.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the delete (forward) execCommand, handling character deletion, collapsed selection removal, block boundary merging, and whitespace canonicalization across editable regions.

nodes.name: fontname.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the fontName execCommand, applying font-family CSS to the current selection.

nodes.name: fontsize.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the fontSize execCommand with comprehensive font size conversion utilities between CSS values, legacy numeric sizes (1-7), and pixel measurements.

nodes.name: forecolor.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the foreColor execCommand, applying CSS color to the current selection with SRGB color serialization for test compatibility.

nodes.name: hilitecolor.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the hiliteColor execCommand, applying background highlight color to the current selection.

nodes.name: BoolOrOptionalString
nodes.summary: Enum representing command values that are either a boolean (for toggle commands like bold) or an optional string (for value-based commands like fontName).

nodes.name: RecordedStateOfCommand
nodes.summary: Struct holding a snapshot of a command state and value for a node, used to preserve formatting during DOM mutations by recording overrides before modification.

nodes.name: CssPropertyName
nodes.summary: Enum mapping execCommand commands to CSS property names with methods for resolving computed style values, setting and removing properties on elements.

nodes.name: CommandName
nodes.summary: Enum with all 38 supported execCommand names providing command dispatch, state/value querying, CSS property mapping, and override recording for the contenteditable implementation.

nodes.name: str
nodes.summary: Handles str logic in the contenteditable execCommand subsystem.

nodes.name: for_command_node_with_inline_activated_values
nodes.summary: Handles for command node with inline activated values logic in the contenteditable execCommand subsystem.

nodes.name: for_command_node_with_value
nodes.summary: Handles for command node with value logic in the contenteditable execCommand subsystem.

nodes.name: resolved_value_for_node
nodes.summary: Resolves a CSS property value for an element by examining computed style, with special handling for background-color transparency, font element attributes, and text-decoration longhands.

nodes.name: value_set_for_style
nodes.summary: Handles value set for style logic in the contenteditable execCommand subsystem.

nodes.name: property_name
nodes.summary: Handles property name logic in the contenteditable execCommand subsystem.

nodes.name: set_for_element
nodes.summary: Handles set for element logic in the contenteditable execCommand subsystem.

nodes.name: is_indeterminate
nodes.summary: Handles is indeterminate logic in the contenteditable execCommand subsystem.

nodes.name: current_state
nodes.summary: Checks whether a command is currently active (true) or inactive (false) for the current selection by examining effective command values of contained nodes.

nodes.name: current_value
nodes.summary: Returns the current value of a command for the current selection, resolving from the first formattable contained node.

nodes.name: are_equivalent_values
nodes.summary: Compares two command values for semantic equivalence, with special handling for CSS color parsing and legacy string formats.

nodes.name: are_loosely_equivalent_values
nodes.summary: Performs a loose comparison of command values allowing minor normalization differences, such as between bare integers and pixel values for font sizes.

nodes.name: record_current_overrides
nodes.summary: Captures the current state and value overrides for all formatting commands before a DOM mutation, enabling restoration after the edit.

nodes.name: execute
